This owned fixture retains a direct method-owned Object seed and an optional independently declared fixed context alongside a complete invariant unary result carrier. Class and static method formals use independent names and scopes. The fixed context contributes no element binding; native variants also retain an unparameterized reference to the result carrier.

The provider invokes an original constructor with partial writes and a callback, then returns an opaque carrier. Frozen callers and an independent observer check raw references, nulls, distinct results, late casts, constructor failures and exact checked/runtime/error identity through four routes. Original entries and metadata are compiled and audited with source and SDK providers; wrong programs and Code-preserving Signature controls guard the proof.
